scientific_integrity: A complete analytic integration is accompanied by an independently programmed exact-rational finite checker. Two relevant 2017 original papers were not available in complete full text, leaving provisional historical priority. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple positive-length metric graphs, uniform arclength independent point pairs, exact population CDF at radii smaller than one third the shortest edge; local index cannot reconstruct all topology, and no noisy finite-sample assertions.
title: The short-distance branch index of a metric graph
